# Accounts Payable: Q3 Late-Payment Analysis

Prepared by Finance Ops, Halvorsen Freight AS — October 2026

## Summary
We looked at every supplier invoice received between July 1 and September 30 (2,148 in total) to understand why our average days-to-pay crept from 31 to 44.

## Findings
- 61% of late invoices were missing a purchase order number, so they sat in the exceptions queue for an average of 9 days.
- Three fuel suppliers account for nearly a third of the late-payment penalties we paid this quarter (NOK 212,400).
- Invoices submitted as scanned PDFs took twice as long to approve as those sent through the supplier portal.

## What this means
The delay is mostly a process problem, not a cash problem. Our recommendation is to reject PO-less invoices at intake and push the remaining paper suppliers onto the portal before Q1.
